findings.quote: instead of waiting for your next yearly checkup
findings.why: The ficha says most people come in about twice a year and that the dentist sets the schedule, so the post's implied yearly recall misstates the clinic's stated practice.
findings.fix: Replace "your next yearly checkup" with "your next scheduled checkup" or "your next checkup", or align the wording with the twice-a-year schedule in the ficha.
